critique: The background color is uniform and lacks visual interest, contributing to a flat aesthetic.
The HUD elements are clear but could benefit from more contrast against the background for better readability.
The health and score indicators are functional but do not convey a sense of urgency or engagement.
priorityFixes: Enhance the background with subtle textures or animations to create depth.
Increase the contrast of the HUD elements by using a brighter color for text and borders.
Consider adding visual feedback for player actions, such as animations or effects when health changes.
